Sandbox_OffGrid_AllowBackup_tooltip: Lets players convert generators into Off-Grid backups. Off stops the ones that are running and refuses new conversions; Convert to normal generator still works.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BackupFuelUse_tooltip: How much gasoline a backup generator burns. 1 burns what a normal generator burns for the same appliances, or in Realistic Mode what a real generator burns. 0 is free.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BankScale_tooltip: Scales how much every battery stores.
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance: Storage barns with spare solar gear (one in)
Sandbox_OffGrid_BarnStockChance_tooltip: On newly explored ground, one hay-storage barn in this many holds a few spare panels and battery racks. 0 means none.
Sandbox_OffGrid_DegradeBank_tooltip: Running batteries flat costs capacity permanently. Cheap chemistries start suffering far sooner than sealed ones.
Sandbox_OffGrid_GridLinkRadius_tooltip: How far a transformer's power line can run, to the controller or to another transformer, in tiles.
Sandbox_OffGrid_LinkRadius_tooltip: How far each component reaches to find the next one. Banks chain, so a run of them can lead away from the controller.
Sandbox_OffGrid_OutputScale_tooltip: Scales everything the panels make. 100 is the physical model.
Sandbox_OffGrid_PickupLock: Who may pick up solar parts
Sandbox_OffGrid_PickupLock_option3: Whoever placed it, their safehouse, admins and moderators
Sandbox_OffGrid_PickupLock_tooltip: Panels and battery banks are expensive to build and trivial to carry off. Mods that remove the tool requirement for moving furniture otherwise make every rig free to take. On a server this also decides who may use a rig's controls: switching a controller, its cables, wiring buildings, and a backup generator's switches and fuel barrels. Anyone nearby may still read the monitor, clean panels, and refuel or repair a backup.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RealisticMode_tooltip: Panels make what panels made in 1993: three modules of about 50 W to a frame, so a standard frame gives about 140 W in full sun, a quarter of the usual. Makeshift frames make about half that, premium frames a little more. Backup generators burn gasoline like real generators: 0.15 L an hour for each kW of their rating, plus 0.45 L for each kWh they deliver.
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance: Houses with a solar rig (one in)
Sandbox_OffGrid_RigChance_tooltip: On newly explored ground, one house in this many has a solar rig in the yard. 0 means none.
Sandbox_OffGrid_SimulateLoad_tooltip: Count what the lights, fridges and ovens in range are drawing. Off means the system only ever charges.
Sandbox_OffGrid_SnowRate_tooltip: How fast snow covers the glass. 0 means it never settles. Roof panels collect faster and shed slower whatever this is set to.
Sandbox_OffGrid_SoilRate_tooltip: How fast dirt cuts output. Rain washes panels either way.
Sandbox_OffGrid_TransformerLoss_tooltip: What each transformer draws while the system has power, even with nothing switched on.
